Home.title: Welcome to the cookbook app
Home.p1: With the MyCookbook app we want users to be able to create their own digital cookbook.
Home.p2: User can make and manage multiple cookbooks. They can add recipes to them.
Home.p3: Each recipe can have multiple ingredients. We want users to also be able to discover new cooking ideas based on certain ingredients.
